proposal.title: Vacant apartment unit painting
proposal.overview: An illustrative interior repaint of vacant apartment units with preparation, application and final walkthrough.

scope.work: Protect floors and fixtures, prepare walls, apply paint
scope.completion: Even coverage and clean edges subject to site walkthrough
Confirm final areas and colors before scheduling

assumptions: Site access and paint colors confirmed before scheduling
Electrical and lighting access arranged by property management
exclusions: Areas outside the agreed walkthrough scope
proposal.timeline: Schedule to be determined after the site walkthrough. No completion date is promised.
